name: AVI Polymers Ltd
tagline: Near-shell micro-cap whose promoter holding collapsed to ~1% while revenue exploded via a trading pivot - unverifiable earnings, HIGH CAUTION
business_overview: AVI Polymers is a BSE micro-cap that historically had negligible operations and pivoted into a large trading business, taking revenue from ~Rs 0.06 Cr to ~Rs 312-379 Cr in a single year.
fundamentals_narrative: The headline growth is extraordinary - revenue from ~Rs 0.06 Cr to ~Rs 312 Cr in a year, PAT up ~2,400% - but the pattern is a red flag, not a thesis: a near-zero-operations company pivoting into low-margin trading revenue that is inherently hard to verify, while promoter holding sits at ~1.1% (down from ~25%). MarketsMojo had downgraded the stock to Sell on valuation. Extreme, volatile ROE (a ~126% quarter) is itself a sustainability red flag.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock up ~179% over a year on the revenue-explosion narrative.
